prompt: A cluster was set up without a license key. What does trial mode allow?
explanation: Without a supplied license the cluster generates a trial license: every feature is available, but the trial is limited to 30 days and 4 shards, counting master and replica shards. The trial period starts on the day you set up the cluster on the first node, and once a real license is applied the cluster cannot go back to trial mode.

options.text: All features for 30 days and up to 4 shards
All features for 7 days and up to 2 shards
All features for 30 days with no shard limit
Read-only access for 30 days, until a license is uploaded
